description: Cooldown and charge manager for JavaScript and TypeScript with named streams, classic timers, multi-charge regeneration, snapshots, events, and deterministic clocks.
rules: Use only the documented version 1 API: tryUse, use, start, remaining, isReady, charges, timeUntilNextCharge, timeUntilFull, pause, resume, reset, delete, snapshot, and restore.
Streams and shared charge pools are in-memory and local to one Coolneur manager instance; do not present them as distributed locks or security-grade rate limits.
